# ATM Error Codes

Generated from `packages/`, `scripts/`, `tests`, and `examples` TypeScript sources plus `docs/governance/error-code-registry.json`.

Regenerate with `npm run generate:error-codes`.

Canonical registry digest: `sha256:721a1eb9aa95e76ddf565898cf1ca1c126f953f6fa2a5dee7251c33baeaf0812`.

## Operator Registry

Curated entries provide the shared operator-facing meaning and recovery path used by ATM skills. Source-scanned codes that are not yet curated appear as `registry-missing` in the source index.

| Code | Category | Description | Retryable | Human Approval | Remediation | Source Owner |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ATM_ATOMIC_WRITE_RETRY_EXHAUSTED` | runtime-write | An atomic write helper exhausted its bounded retry budget before it could safely persist state. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs broker status --json to inspect the current shared-write owner.&lt;br&gt;- Run node atm.mjs taskflow diagnose --task &lt;task-id&gt; --json before retrying the write.&lt;br&gt;- Retry only after the status command shows the owning lane or recovery action. | `packages/cli/src/commands/broker/persistence.ts` |
| `ATM_BATCH_PLAN_DIGEST_MISMATCH` | batch | A durable plan batch run resume observed a plan digest that differs from the pinned run digest. | yes | yes | - Inspect the current batch run with node atm.mjs batch status --batch &lt;id&gt; --json.&lt;br&gt;- If the plan change is intentional, rerun the plan execution command with an explicit accept-plan-change flag once implemented.&lt;br&gt;- Otherwise restore the original plan/task set before resuming the batch run. | `packages/core/src/batch/plan-run-journal.ts` |
| `ATM_BATCH_PLANNING_CLOSEBACK_CONFLICT` | batch | A plan-level batch closeback compare-and-swap seal conflicted with the planning mirror state. | yes | no | - Refresh the planning mirror status and compare the seal digest.&lt;br&gt;- Resume the batch only after resolving the planning-card amendment or closeback order.&lt;br&gt;- Keep target-repo closure and planning mirror closeback in one governed saga. | `packages/cli/src/commands/batch/implementation.ts` |
| `ATM_BATCH_PUSH_DIVERGED` | git-governance | A batch run cannot fast-forward its target branch because the remote branch diverged. | no | yes | - Fetch and inspect the divergence before retrying the push.&lt;br&gt;- Use the governed git admission flow once available for batch-level divergence recovery.&lt;br&gt;- Rerun required validators after reconciling the branch head. | `packages/cli/src/commands/batch/implementation.ts` |
| `ATM_BATCH_RUN_EVENT_JOURNAL_INVALID` | batch | A durable plan batch run journal event could not be appended or read as a valid append-only event. | no | no | - Run node atm.mjs batch status --batch &lt;id&gt; --json to inspect the active run.&lt;br&gt;- Recreate the plan batch run if the runtime journal is corrupted.&lt;br&gt;- Do not hand-edit .atm/runtime/batch-runs/*.journal.jsonl. | `packages/core/src/batch/plan-run-journal.ts` |
| `ATM_BROKER_AUTHORIZATION_DIMENSION_MISMATCH` | team-broker | Broker authorization was requested for a different resource dimension than the ticket actually grants. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs broker status --json to inspect current broker tickets and ownership.&lt;br&gt;- Re-arbitrate with the requested resource dimension and granted resource dimension recorded in the recovery evidence.&lt;br&gt;- Do not replace resource-dimension checks with task-id allowlists. | `packages/core/src/broker/ticket-authority` |
| `ATM_BROKER_COMPOSE_SEMANTIC_VALIDATION_FAILED` | team-broker | An exact composed candidate executed required semantic validators and at least one command-backed result failed. | yes | no | - Repair or recompute the conflicting proposals against the current base/HEAD.&lt;br&gt;- Rematerialize the exact composed candidate and rerun the same sealed validator set with node atm.mjs broker post-compose-semantic-validation --candidate-file &lt;path&gt; --json.&lt;br&gt;- Do not authorize a canonical write, skip the failing validator, or substitute a healthy boolean for the failed command-backed result. | `packages/core/src/broker/post-compose-semantic-validation-policy.ts` |
| `ATM_BROKER_COMPOSE_SEMANTIC_VALIDATION_UNAVAILABLE` | team-broker | A required language or project validator could not be resolved, executed, or proven with a command-backed result. | yes | no | - Restore or resolve the declared language/project validator named by the sealed selection source.&lt;br&gt;- Rematerialize the exact composed candidate and rerun semantic validation with node atm.mjs broker post-compose-semantic-validation --candidate-file &lt;path&gt; --json.&lt;br&gt;- Do not skip the unavailable validator, invent a healthy boolean, or authorize a canonical write while validation remains unavailable. | `packages/core/src/broker/post-compose-semantic-validation-policy.ts` |
| `ATM_BROKER_REARBITRATION_REQUIRED` | team-broker | Broker admission evidence is stale, incomplete, or dimension-mismatched and must be re-arbitrated before write continuation. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs broker status --json to inspect the current shared-surface state.&lt;br&gt;- Rerun the admission or broker conflict resolution command for the current task, actor, and resource dimension.&lt;br&gt;- Proceed only after the new broker ticket or conflict-resolution artifact matches the attempted write. | `packages/core/src/broker/ticket-authority` |
| `ATM_BROKER_RUNNER_SYNC_RELEASED` | team-broker | Runner-sync steward queue head was released after receipt-backed build/publication evidence. | no | no | - No remediation is required; inspect evidence.release.next for the next steward work item, if any. | `packages/cli/src/commands/broker.ts` |
| `ATM_BROKER_STATE_DIVERGENCE` | team-broker | Broker replay or census observed divergent shared-surface state that must be inspected before more writes continue. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs broker status --json to inspect the live shared-surface registry.&lt;br&gt;- Run the task-provided replay or census validator to identify the divergent state class.&lt;br&gt;- Do not continue shared writes until the divergent broker state has been reconciled or waived by the owning governance task. | `packages/core/src/broker/replay` |
| `ATM_BROKER_STEWARD_RECEIPT_INVALID` | team-broker | A steward receipt for a shared mutation is malformed, unsupported, stale, already consumed, mismatched, or does not prove canonicalWriteCount: 1. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs broker status --json to inspect the current base/HEAD and existing proposal/receipt state.&lt;br&gt;- Rebuild the composition with node atm.mjs broker compose --proposal-file &lt;proposal&gt; --json against the current base/HEAD.&lt;br&gt;- Obtain a fresh steward apply receipt with node atm.mjs broker steward apply --merge-plan-file &lt;plan&gt; --proposal-file &lt;proposal&gt; --scope-file &lt;path&gt; --evidence-out &lt;receipt&gt; --json; do not reuse or hand-edit the prior receipt. | `packages/core/src/broker/shared-write-provenance-policy.ts` |
| `ATM_BROKER_STEWARD_RECEIPT_REQUIRED` | team-broker | A multi-claim shared mutation reached a side-effect boundary without a steward composition/apply receipt. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs broker status --json to inspect active write-claim cardinality and existing proposals for the file.&lt;br&gt;- Route the change through node atm.mjs broker compose --proposal-file &lt;proposal&gt; --json to build a composed candidate.&lt;br&gt;- Obtain a steward apply receipt with node atm.mjs broker steward apply --merge-plan-file &lt;plan&gt; --proposal-file &lt;proposal&gt; --scope-file &lt;path&gt; --evidence-out &lt;receipt&gt; --json before staging or committing the file. | `packages/core/src/broker/shared-write-provenance-policy.ts` |
| `ATM_BROKER_TICKET_STALE_GENERATION` | team-broker | A broker ticket was based on an older generation than the current shared-surface registry. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs broker status --json and compare the current generation with the ticket generation.&lt;br&gt;- Discard the stale ticket and rerun the admission or arbitration command that produced it.&lt;br&gt;- If the stale ticket represents completed work, reconcile it through the owning task evidence instead of applying it. | `packages/core/src/broker/ticket-authority` |
| `ATM_CLAIM_FOREIGN_UNSTAGED_WIP` | claim-admission | A candidate claim intersects foreign or unowned dirty WIP in the shared worktree. | yes | no | - Ask the owning lane to commit, close, release, or hand off before claiming the overlapping code scope.&lt;br&gt;- If ownership is unowned, inspect the dirty file and either bind it to the right task or clear it through a governed cleanup.&lt;br&gt;- Docs-only or ledger-only claims can proceed because this gate applies only to candidate code scope. | `packages/cli/src/commands/next/foreign-dirty-wip-admission.ts` |
| `ATM_EMERGENCY_LANE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED` | emergency | A protected backend flag requires a human-approved emergency lease. | yes | yes | - For open or planned task import drift, retry tasks import --force after confirming the source planning authority; this should not require emergency approval.&lt;br&gt;- For active claims, use handoff, release, or repair-claim before importing.&lt;br&gt;- For closed target-authority history overwrites, obtain explicit human approval only when a governed repair or migration requires it. | `packages/cli/src/commands/emergency/gate.ts` |
| `ATM_EVIDENCE_SEAL_REQUIRED` | evidence | A governed operation requires sealed command-backed evidence before the task can checkpoint, close, or publish. | yes | no | - Run the task's focused validator and preserve stdout/stderr digests.&lt;br&gt;- Add evidence with node atm.mjs evidence add --task &lt;task-id&gt; --actor &lt;actor&gt; --kind test --freshness fresh --summary "&lt;summary&gt;" --command "&lt;command&gt;" --exit-code 0 --json.&lt;br&gt;- Retry the checkpoint or closeout only after the evidence verify command passes. | `packages/cli/src/commands/evidence.ts` |
| `ATM_GIT_COMMIT_BRANCH_QUEUE_BUSY` | git-governance | Another governed commit is currently finalizing the same branch. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs git commit-status --actor &lt;actor&gt; --json to inspect the branchCommitQueueStatus owner and age.&lt;br&gt;- If the owner is alive, wait for it to finish and retry the same governed commit command.&lt;br&gt;- If the owner is stale or dead, inspect the lock path and current HEAD before cleaning it through the governed recovery lane. | `packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance.ts` |
| `ATM_GIT_COMMIT_BROKER_CONFLICT_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED` | team-broker | A Team Broker ownership conflict blocks commit bypass until a recorded conflict-resolution artifact and approval exist. | yes | yes | - Resolve the ownership conflict through a paper-style broker conflict-resolution artifact.&lt;br&gt;- Obtain the required backend.brokerConflictOverride approval only when a human has approved the override.&lt;br&gt;- Retry the governed commit with --broker-conflict-resolution and the approved lease. | `packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance.ts` |
| `ATM_GIT_COMMIT_FAILED` | git-governance | The governed git commit wrapper failed while preparing or finalizing a commit. | yes | no | - Inspect the top-level JSON details for nestedErrorCode, attemptPath, affected files, and nextSafeAction.&lt;br&gt;- Run node atm.mjs git commit-status --actor &lt;actor&gt; --task &lt;task-id&gt; --json to inspect the latest attempt and branch queue state.&lt;br&gt;- Do not retry the same command blindly when the nested error says the candidate must be reduced, split, or revalidated. | `packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance/implementation.ts` |
| `ATM_GIT_COMMIT_STDIN_PATHSPEC_ADD_ACTIVE` | git-governance | A git add helper using stdin pathspecs is active and can make a governed commit appear hung. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs git commit-status --actor &lt;actor&gt; --json and inspect stdinPathspecGitAddProcesses.&lt;br&gt;- Wait briefly for the listed helper to finish, or terminate only the listed stuck git add process after confirming it is the stdin pathspec helper.&lt;br&gt;- Manual staging with git add -- &lt;paths&gt; is normal and safe when the path list is finite and reviewed.&lt;br&gt;- For governed scoped delivery, prefer node atm.mjs git commit --auto-stage; ATM auto-stage uses explicit git add -- &lt;paths&gt; and does not use stdin pathspec staging. | `packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance.ts` |
| `ATM_GIT_COMMIT_STDIN_PATHSPEC_ADD_CLEAR` | git-governance | No active stdin pathspec git add helper is currently visible to ATM commit-status. | yes | no | - Proceed with explicit staging or the governed ATM auto-stage lane.&lt;br&gt;- If the UI still appears stuck, inspect the branch commit queue and recent commit attempt status before retrying. | `packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance.ts` |
| `ATM_GIT_RECORD_COMMIT_PAYLOAD_DROPPED` | git-governance | git record-commit created a commit that omitted explicitly staged record files. | yes | no | - Treat the commit as failed governance delivery&lt;br&gt;- Re-stage missing record files&lt;br&gt;- Prefer temporary-index commit paths for metadata repairs | `packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance/record-commit-payload-assertion.ts` |
| `ATM_HISTORICAL_WORK_ADMISSION_ATTESTATION_INVALID` | write-ticket | A historical work-admission attestation is malformed, mismatched, conflicting, or targets a non-ancestor commit. | no | yes | - Do not edit historical commits or force-push.&lt;br&gt;- Remove the invalid forward record through governed recovery and create one exact attestation from the immutable commit metadata. | `packages/core/src/broker/historical-work-admission-attestation.ts` |

| `ATM_LANE_ADOPT_TOKEN_MISMATCH` | lane-session | The provided handoff token does not match the lane session token hash. | yes | no | - Confirm the handoff token with the lane owner, or wait for TTL expiry / use --confirm for same-handle recovery. | `packages/cli/src/commands/lane.ts` |

| `ATM_LANE_SESSION_HEARTBEAT_EXPIRED` | lane-session | A TTL-expired lane session cannot be revived by heartbeat. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs lane status --actor &lt;actor&gt; --json to mint a fresh lane.&lt;br&gt;- Run node atm.mjs lane sweep --write --json only when explicit cleanup evidence is desired. | `packages/cli/src/commands/lane.ts` |
| `ATM_LANE_SESSION_HEARTBEAT_RECORDED` | lane-session | A lane session heartbeat was recorded and the lane TTL was extended. | no | no | - No remediation is required; inspect evidence.eventPath for the heartbeat event when auditing. | `packages/cli/src/commands/lane.ts` |

| `ATM_LANE_SESSION_NOT_ADOPTABLE` | lane-session | The requested lane session is closed and cannot be adopted. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs lane status --actor &lt;actor&gt; --json to mint or resolve a current lane.&lt;br&gt;- Use lane sweep only for command-backed cleanup of expired lanes. | `packages/cli/src/commands/lane.ts` |

| `ATM_LANE_SESSION_NOT_STALE` | lane-session | The requested lane is still within TTL and cannot be adopted without confirmation or a handoff token. | yes | no | - Wait for TTL expiry, or rerun with --confirm for same-handle recovery.&lt;br&gt;- Provide --handoff-token when adopting a live handoff-authorized lane. | `packages/cli/src/commands/lane.ts` |

| `ATM_NEXT_TASK_SCOPE_NOT_FOUND` | routing | ATM could not match the prompt to an imported task card or ledger task. | yes | no | - If authoring a new task, create or update the planning card first.&lt;br&gt;- Dry-run import the planning card with node atm.mjs tasks import --from &lt;card&gt; --dry-run --json.&lt;br&gt;- When the dry run is clean, import with --write and commit the ledger import bundle before claiming implementation. | `packages/cli/src/commands/next.ts` |
| `ATM_ORPHAN_CLAIM_ADOPTABLE` | claim-admission | A task has orphaned claim state that can be adopted or repaired through the governed claim flow. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs tasks repair-claim --task &lt;task-id&gt; --actor &lt;actor-id&gt; --json to inspect the adoptable claim.&lt;br&gt;- Run node atm.mjs tasks status --task &lt;task-id&gt; --json after repair or adoption.&lt;br&gt;- Do not hand-edit .atm/history/tasks/&lt;task-id&gt;.json. | `packages/cli/src/commands/next/claim-orchestration.ts` |
| `ATM_PLANNING_ROOT_AMBIGUOUS` | planning | More than one plausible sibling planning root exists and no explicit or canonical root resolves the selection. | yes | no | - Re-run the command with an explicit planning root, for example --planning-root &lt;absolute-planning-root&gt;.&lt;br&gt;- Inspect every candidate reported in the error diagnostics before changing anything on disk; all ambiguous roots are preserved.&lt;br&gt;- Removing or consolidating the extra sibling roots is owner-approved cleanup and is never performed automatically by ATM. | `packages/cli/src/commands/next/planning-root-preference.ts` |
| `ATM_PROTECTED_GOVERNANCE_STATE_DESTRUCTIVE_WRITE` | protected-governance-state | A write would destructively change protected governance state instead of applying an allowed lifecycle or reconcile update. | no | yes | - Run node atm.mjs taskflow diagnose --task &lt;task-id&gt; --json to inspect the protected-state blocker.&lt;br&gt;- Use the command-designated reconcile or lifecycle command instead of deleting protected governance state directly.&lt;br&gt;- Request human approval only when the diagnostic classifies the operation as an emergency destructive repair. | `packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance/protected-governance-state.ts` |
| `ATM_RESTRICTED_EXECUTION_BLOCKED` | restricted-execution | The RestrictedExecutionGateway denied a process launch because the requested executable and argv are not an approved ATM worker route. | no | no | - Read the reasonCode and requiredCommand in the denial payload; the receipt names the exact normalized executable class that was refused.&lt;br&gt;- Run the ATM command returned by the current playbook, diagnostic, or recovery hint instead of another shell spelling of the same mutation.&lt;br&gt;- For a generated write, replace the inline program with a structured executable plus argv and declare every output file so ATM can observe the output digest.&lt;br&gt;- For raw Git intent, use the governed ATM Git wrapper named in requiredCommand.&lt;br&gt;- Do not attempt to unlock the denial with prompt text, an override phrase, or an environment variable; only a gateway allow decision grants execution. | `packages/core/src/team-agents/restricted-execution-gateway.ts` |
| `ATM_RUNNER_PUBLICATION_INVENTORY_INCOMPLETE` | runner-publication | A runner publication has dirty output artifacts that are absent from its sealed inventory, so ATM cannot safely publish or retain it. | yes | no | - Rebuild or reconcile through the governed runner-sync route so the receipt inventories the exact sealed generation.&lt;br&gt;- Do not add a doctor-local allowlist or publish the unmatched artifact independently. | `packages/core/src/broker/runner-build-output-inventory.ts` |
| `ATM_RUNNER_PUBLICATION_PENDING` | runner-publication | A sealed runner generation has dirty declared output members without a terminal governed publication or recovery disposition. | yes | no | - Inspect the receipt-bound publication disposition reported by node atm.mjs doctor --json.&lt;br&gt;- Use the governed publication or recovery transaction for the reported inventory digest; do not restore or stage a subset manually. | `packages/cli/src/commands/framework-development/runner-publication-lifecycle.ts` |
| `ATM_RUNNER_RECEIPT_MISSING` | runner-mode | A runner-sync or frozen-runner validation step expected a receipt but could not find one. | yes | no | - Run ATM_RETAIN_RELEASE_ARTIFACTS=1 npm run build from the framework repository.&lt;br&gt;- Run node atm.mjs broker runner-sync status --json when runner-sync broker state exists.&lt;br&gt;- Rerun the frozen node atm.mjs command that required the receipt. | `packages/cli/src/commands/next/runner-mode.ts` |
| `ATM_RUNNER_STALE_LEDGER_WRITE_ALLOWED` | runner-mode | A stale frozen runner warning was downgraded because the command writes only task ledger import records. | no | no | - Continue the ledger import; no human emergency lease is required for clean Tier 1 ledger ingestion.&lt;br&gt;- Run runner-sync separately before code, build, release, or validation work that depends on frozen runner freshness. | `packages/cli/src/commands/tasks/import-orchestrator.ts` |
| `ATM_RUNNER_STALE_WRITE_REFUSED` | runner-mode | ATM refused a frozen-runner write because the stable runner is older than source changes. | yes | no | - If no other captain owns release surfaces, run ATM_RETAIN_RELEASE_ARTIFACTS=1 npm run build and retry the frozen node atm.mjs write command.&lt;br&gt;- If another captain owns release/generated or release mirrors, enqueue broker runner-sync work for the sealed source SHA and wait for the steward release receipt.&lt;br&gt;- For read-only source-first validation only, use node atm.dev.mjs; do not use source-first writes to bypass frozen-runner governance. | `packages/cli/src/commands/framework-development/closure-packet-schema.ts` |
| `ATM_RUNNER_SYNC_COALESCED_ATTRIBUTION_MISSING` | runner-mode | A coalesced runner-sync publication was attempted without a child receipt for every group member; the release is refused to prevent a single-task receipt from dropping the group. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs broker runner-sync status --json and compare group manifest members to published child receipts.&lt;br&gt;- Regenerate one attributable child receipt per member before finalizing publication.&lt;br&gt;- Do not release the queue head until member attribution is complete. | `packages/core/src/broker/runner-version-contract.ts` |
| `ATM_RUNNER_SYNC_ORPHAN` | runner-mode | Runner-sync state references a build, reservation, receipt, or release artifact that no active steward owns. | yes | no | - Read runnerMode.sourceDrift in the failing command output and inspect node atm.mjs broker status --json.&lt;br&gt;- If the source is stale and you own release surfaces, run ATM_RETAIN_RELEASE_ARTIFACTS=1 npm run build.&lt;br&gt;- If ownership is unclear, reconcile the orphan through the broker steward or task evidence before retrying writes. | `packages/cli/src/commands/runner-mode` |
| `ATM_RUNNER_SYNC_REQUIRED` | runner-mode | The frozen ATM runner is older than source changes and must be rebuilt before frozen-runner validation is trusted. | yes | no | - Run ATM_RETAIN_RELEASE_ARTIFACTS=1 npm run build from the framework repository.&lt;br&gt;- Rerun the same node atm.mjs command after the build and confirm runnerMode.sourceDrift.syncRequired is false. | `packages/cli/src/commands/runner-mode` |
| `ATM_RUNNER_SYNC_RESUME_REQUIRED` | runner-mode | A crashed or interrupted runner-sync session must be reconciled and deterministically resumed with member attribution preserved before publication. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs broker runner-sync status --json and reconcile the durable session state.&lt;br&gt;- Resume the build for the recorded coalesced members rather than re-enqueuing individually.&lt;br&gt;- Only finalize publication once every member has an attributable child receipt. | `packages/core/src/broker/runner-version-contract.ts` |
| `ATM_RUNNER_SYNC_SEAL_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED` | runner-mode | A runner-affecting delta broke sealed-input continuity, so the affected output closure must be revalidated before a coalesced runner-sync publication can be trusted. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs broker runner-sync status --json and inspect the affected closure segments.&lt;br&gt;- Reseal only the affected closure, or rerun ATM_RETAIN_RELEASE_ARTIFACTS=1 npm run build when a full refresh is required.&lt;br&gt;- Re-select the runner version against the current sealed source before retrying publication. | `packages/core/src/broker/runner-version-contract.ts` |

## Prefix Recovery Rules

Prefix rules are canonical fallback guidance for source-scanned ATM codes that do not yet have an exact curated entry. Exact entries always win. A code is `registry-missing` only when neither an exact entry nor a prefix rule covers it.

| Prefix | Category | Description | Retryable | Human Approval | Remediation | Source Owner |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ATM_TASKFLOW_*` | taskflow | Taskflow refused or diagnosed a task open, pre-close, close, delivery, or evidence transition. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs taskflow pre-close --task &lt;task-id&gt; --actor &lt;actor&gt; --json for close-readiness details.&lt;br&gt;- Inspect excludedDirtyFiles, missing validators, and commit-bundle diagnostics before retrying close.&lt;br&gt;- Use taskflow close only after real deliverables and validator evidence exist. | `packages/cli/src/commands/taskflow.ts` |
| `ATM_VALIDATE_*` | validation | An ATM validation command found a failing invariant, stale projection, missing evidence, or governance mismatch. | yes | no | - Read the validator output and rerun the same command after the focused repair.&lt;br&gt;- If the validator names a generated projection, run the paired --write or generator command first.&lt;br&gt;- Do not treat validation output as task evidence until the command exits successfully. | `scripts/validate-*` |
| `ATM_BROKER_*` | team-broker | Team Broker, shared surface, steward, or conflict admission reported a guarded condition. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs broker status --json to inspect current shared-surface ownership.&lt;br&gt;- Do not bypass broker-conflict-blocked results; obtain a conflict-resolution artifact and required approval when the diagnostic asks for one.&lt;br&gt;- Prefer waiting, steward release, or documented takeover over ad hoc staging or direct runtime edits. | `packages/core/src/broker` |
| `ATM_RUNNER_*` | runner-mode | Frozen-runner freshness, runner-sync, or release publication governance reported a guarded condition. | yes | no | - Read runnerMode.sourceDrift in the command output before retrying writes.&lt;br&gt;- If syncRequired is true and you own release surfaces, run ATM_RETAIN_RELEASE_ARTIFACTS=1 npm run build.&lt;br&gt;- If another actor owns release surfaces, use broker runner-sync enqueue/status and wait for the steward receipt. | `packages/cli/src/commands/runner-mode` |
| `ATM_GUARD_*` | guard | A local ATM guard found a policy, encoding, framework-development, or protected-state condition. | yes | no | - Read the guard report findings and repair only the listed files or state.&lt;br&gt;- Run the same guard command again after the focused repair.&lt;br&gt;- Do not bypass guard findings unless a documented emergency approval explicitly allows that protected action. | `packages/cli/src/commands/guard.ts` |
| `ATM_NEXT_*` | routing | Prompt-scoped routing, claim admission, or next-action guidance reported a guarded condition. | yes | no | - Rerun node atm.mjs next --prompt "&lt;current goal&gt;" --json and read evidence.nextAction before editing.&lt;br&gt;- If the prompt refers to a planning card, import or identify the target-repo task before claim.&lt;br&gt;- If active work exists, inspect broker and task status before widening scope. | `packages/cli/src/commands/next.ts` |
| `ATM_TASK_*` | task-ledger | Task ledger, task scope, claim, audit, or lifecycle governance reported a guarded condition. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs tasks status --task &lt;task-id&gt; --json for the current ledger and claim state.&lt;br&gt;- Use node atm.mjs next --prompt "&lt;current goal&gt;" --json when the correct task route is unclear.&lt;br&gt;- Do not hand-edit .atm/history task records; use the ATM task lifecycle command named by the diagnostic. | `packages/cli/src/commands/tasks` |
| `ATM_TEAM_*` | team-agents | Team Agents planning, start, validation, runtime, knowledge, or roster governance reported a guarded condition. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs team status --compact --json to inspect active Team runs.&lt;br&gt;- Rerun the relevant team plan or validate command with the same --task and --recipe values.&lt;br&gt;- Coordinator remains the task lifecycle and git.write owner unless Team start --execute explicitly granted a governed execution lane. | `packages/cli/src/commands/team-legacy.ts` |
| `ATM_CLI_*` | cli-usage | The ATM CLI parser or command dispatcher rejected the command shape. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs &lt;command&gt; --help for the supported options and examples.&lt;br&gt;- Retry with explicit --json, --actor, --task, or required positional arguments named by the diagnostic.&lt;br&gt;- Do not infer missing task or actor identity from dirty files. | `packages/cli/src/atm.ts` |
| `ATM_GIT_*` | git-governance | Git governance, staging, commit, branch queue, or push admission reported a guarded condition. | yes | no | - Run node atm.mjs git commit-status --actor &lt;actor&gt; --json when the condition happened during commit or staging.&lt;br&gt;- Run node atm.mjs git admit --actor &lt;actor&gt; --branch &lt;branch&gt; --remote origin --json before protected push retries.&lt;br&gt;- Do not bypass hooks or broker conflicts unless an explicit emergency approval names the required backend permission. | `packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance.ts` |
| `ATM_*` | general | ATM reported a guarded condition that does not yet have a narrower exact entry or prefix rule. | yes | no | - Read the command's JSON details and messages before retrying.&lt;br&gt;- Run npm run generate:error-codes to refresh the source index and locate the owning source context.&lt;br&gt;- Add an exact registry entry when the code is user-visible or appears in recurring operator reports. | `docs/governance/error-code-registry.json` |
